conditions.evidence: recent diagnosis of unilateral breast cancer
conditions.label: unilateral breast cancer

output.population: Women with a recent diagnosis of unilateral breast cancer and no abnormalities on mammographic and clinical examination of the contralateral breast, who underwent breast MRI.
output.summary: Breast imaging collection from ACRIN trial 6667, testing whether MRI improves on clinical breast examination and mammography for detecting contralateral breast cancer soon after a diagnosis of unilateral breast cancer.
